## Appraisals
Students found several aspects of the Topics course praiseworthy. They appreciated the quality of the course material, noting that it was functioning nicely and that seminars, material, and debates were engaging. The substance of the classes was also praised, as was the organization of the syllabus. Additionally, students enjoyed the fresh and novel concepts being covered, and the coding portions were deemed to be proceeding well. The Python segment was particularly highlighted as superb, and the content was described as both adequate and superb. The professor's teaching style was liked, and the sessions were described as lively and entertaining.

## Criticisms
Some students expressed concerns about the outdated nature of the course material and syllabus. They felt that the subjects and themes were not modern or cutting-edge, which hindered their ability to apply the ideas practically. One student specifically mentioned difficulty in applying the logic and ideas without sufficient practical examples. Another issue raised was the pacing of the course, with some students finding it too slow and dragging.

## Suggestions
Improvements suggested by students included incorporating more practical applications of the ideas, such as showing examples using Python notebooks. There was also a suggestion to modernize the subject content, focusing on contemporary algorithms and practical Natural Language Processing (NLP) uses. Some students recommended altering the presentation style to make it more lucid and accurate, reducing the emphasis on overly theoretical assignments. Lastly, there was a suggestion to organize the classes better and provide clearer, more rigorous theories.
